senses.gloss:
फल् फल्, cl. 1. P. फलति, पफाल
(3rd pl. फेलुस्), फलिष्यति, अफालीत्,
फलितुम्, to split (intrans.) cleave asunder, burst,
cleave open (intrans.), burst open, burst asunder
(Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 7472); to bear fruit, yield
or produce fruit, (सम्पदः फल्, to bring forth
successes as fruit, have a reward); to be fruitful; to have
results or consequences; to result; to succeed; to be
fruitful in, be fulfilled by (with abl.); to fall to the
share of any one (with loc.), befall; to be useful;
to become ripe, ripen; to produce; to shine back,
be reflected; to go (for पल्): Caus. फालयति, अपी-
फलत्: Desid. पिफलिषति: Intens. पम्फुल्यते,
पम्फुल्ति; [cf. Gr. ἐκ-φλαίν-ω, ἔ-φλαδ-ον, φλα-σ-μό-ς
πα-φλάζ-ω; perhaps ὄφελος, ὀφέλλω: Lat.
fla-re, fla-tu-s, flâ-men, flâ-bru-m, flô-s, flôr-eo,
Flora: Osc. Flusa: Goth. uf-blês-an, bloth, blô-
ma: Old Germ. blâ-an, ‘to blow;’ blus-jan, ‘to
bloom;’ bluot, ‘a blossom;’ blâs, ‘blowing;’ blâsa,
bla-tara, ‘bladder;’ bluot, ‘blood;’ bloz, ‘proud:’
Angl. Sax. blowan, bloma, blostma: Cambro-Brit.
pâl, ‘a spread;’ palad, ‘a shooting or spreading
out;’ paladu, ‘to spread or shoot out.’]

फल, अम्, n. a fruit, fruit (especially that of a
tree); produce, crop; a kernel, (दाडिम-फ्˚, the
kernel of a pomegranate); fruit metaphorically,
offspring, progeny, a child (Raghu-v. XIV. 39); a
result, consequence, effect [cf. निष्-फ्˚, पुण्य-फ्˚,
पुरः-फ्˚]; profit, gain, interest on capital, ad-
vantage, benefit, utility; recompense, reward, prize,
meed, retribution (good or bad); detriment, loss,
disadvantage; (in mathematics) the result of a cal-
culation, product or quotient, result (in trigonome-
try); second term in a rule of three sum; corrective
equation; area or superficial contents of a figure;
a nutmeg; the three myrobalans (= त्रि-फला); a
testicle; a blade (of a sword or knife, cf. खड्ग-
फ्˚); a tablet, board [cf. शारि-फ्˚]; a shield; the
point of an arrow, head of a dart or spear; a point
or spot on a die; a ploughshare (= फाल); the
menstrual discharge [cf. नव-फलिका, पुष्प];
a gift, giving; (अस्), m. the plant Wrightia Antidy-
senterica, = कुटज; (आ), f. a species of shrub, =
झिञ्झिरिष्टा; (ई), f. a species of fragrant plant
(= फलिनी, प्रियङ्गु); a kind of fish (= फलि).
—फल-कक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a Yakṣa.
—फल-
कण्टका, f. the plant Asclepias Echinata.
—फल-
कामना, f. desire of a result or consequence.
—फल-काल, अस्, m. the time of fruits, fruit
season.
—फल-कृष्ण, अस्, m. Carissa Carandas
or Flacourtia Cataphracta (= कृष्ण-पाक-फल).
—फल-केशर, अस्, m. ‘having fruit for hair,’
the cocoa-nut tree (the fruit of which is covered
with a fibrous coat resembling hair).
—फल-कोश
or फल-कोषक, अस्, m. the covering of the
testicles, the scrotum.
—फल-खण्डन, अम्, n.
the destruction of fruits, frustration of results, dis-
[]
appointing.
—फल-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘receiving
fruits,’ deriving profit or advantage, benefited; (अस्),
m. the deriving profit or advantage, being benefited.
—फल-ग्रहि, इस्, इस्, इ, fruitful, bearing fruit in due
season.
—फल-ग्रहिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, fruit-bearing,
fruitful.
—फल-ग्राहिन्, ई, m. ‘fruit-bearer,’ a tree
(properly a fruit tree).
—फल-घृत, अम्, n., Ved.
‘fruit-ghee,’ N. of an aphrodisiac for men (which
is composed of various ingredients, and said to be
the invention of Bharad-vāja); N. of a powerful me-
dicament used in diseases of the uterus.
—फल-
चमस, अस्, m. ‘fruit-goblet,’ a cup containing
fruit instead of Soma (Ved. the fruit consisting of
pounded figs, young leaves, and sour milk); the bark
of the Indian fig-tree (ground and eaten with curds
by way of penance).
—फल-चारक, अस्, m. ‘fruit-
distributor,’ a particular official in Buddhist monasteries.
—फल-चोरक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume.
—फ-
ल-च्छदन, अम्, n. a house built of wooden boards.
—फल-तस्, ind. consequently, accordingly, virtu-
ally.
—फल-ता, f. or फल-त्व, अम्, n. the being
fruit, the state of fruit.
—फल-त्रय, अम्, n. ‘fruit-
triad,’ three sorts of fruit collectively (the fruit of the
vine with those of Grewia Asiatica or Xylocarpus Gra-
natum and Gmelina Arborea); the three myrobalans.
—फल-त्रिक, अम्, n. ‘fruit-triad,’ the three myro-
balans.
—फल-द, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘fruit-giving,’ yield-
ing or bearing fruit; bringing profit or gain; giving
a reward, rewarding; (अस्), m. a tree (properly a
fruit tree).
—फल-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or फल-
दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘fruit-giving,’ yielding fruit; giving
a result.
—फल-निर्वृत्ति, इस्, f. final consequence
or result.
—फल-निवृत्ति, इस्, f. cessation of con-
sequences.
—फल-निष्पत्ति, इस्, f. production of
fruit, bearing fruit, yielding profit, having the desired
results.
—फल-पञ्चाम्ल, अम्, n. a collection of
five kinds of acid vegetables and fruits; (see फ-
लाम्ल-पञ्चक.)
—फल-परिणति, इस्, f. the ripe-
ness of fruit.
—फल-पाक, अस्, m. the ripening of
fruit; the fulness of consequences; Carissa Carandas
or Flacourtia Cataphracta; [cf. पाक-फल and
कृष्ण-पाकफल.]
—फलपाकान्त (˚क-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, ending with the ripening of fruit; (आ),
f. an annual plant.
—फलपाकावसाना (˚क-अव्˚),
f. ‘terminating with ripeness of fruit,’ an annual plant.
—फलपाकिन्, ई, m. the plant Thespesia Popul-
neoides.
—फल-पातन, अम्, n. knocking down
or gathering fruit.
—फल-पादप, अस्, m. a fruit
tree.
—फल-पुच्छ, अस्, m. a particular species
of esculent root or bulb.
—फल-पुर, अम्,
n., N. of a city (= फलक-पुर).
—फल-
पुष्प-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase or growth of fruits
and flowers.
—फल-पुष्पा or फल-पुष्पी, f.
Ipomœa Turpethum (= पिण्ड-खर्जूरी).
—फल-
पुष्पोपशोभित (˚प-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, adorned
with fruits and flowers.
—फल-पूर or फल-
पूरक, अस्, m. ‘full of kernels,’ common citron.
—फल-प्रचयन, अम्, n. fruit-gathering, gather-
ing fruits.
—फल-प्रजनन, अम्, n. the produc-
tion of fruit.
—फल-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, yielding
fruit, productive; bringing a reward.
—फल-प्र-
दान, अम्, n. the giving of fruits; a ceremony at
weddings.
—फल-प्रयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, connected
with or producing consequences, yielding fruit.
—फल-प्रसूति, इस्, f. a growth of fruit, crop of
fruit.
—फल-प्राप्ति, इस्, f. obtaining (the desired)
fruit or result; enjoying the consequences of actions.
—फल-प्रिया, f. a species of fragrant plant (=
प्रियङ्गु).
—फल-प्रेप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to
obtain fruit, desirous of attaining results.
—फल-
बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, forming or developing fruit,
setting (said of blossom).
—फल-बन्ध्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, barren or destitute of fruit, not bearing fruit;
[cf. फलाबन्ध्य.]
—फल-भाग, अस्, m. a
share in any product, share of advantage or profit;
N. of an astrological work.
—फल-भागिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, sharing in the profit or advantage, partaking of a
reward.
—फल-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, receiving or having
fruit, having consequences; sharing in a reward.
—फल-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, enjoying fruit.
—फल-
भूति, इस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
—फल-भूमि,
[]
इस्, f. ‘the land of retribution,’ a place of reward or
recompense (as heaven, hell, &c.).
—फल-भृत्,
त्, त्, त्, fruit-bearing, fruitful, productive.
—फल-
भोग, अस्, m. enjoyment of consequences; possession
of rent or profit, usufruct.
—फल-भोगिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, enjoying fruits or consequences, receiving profits.
—फल-मत्स्या, f. the aloe plant.
—फल-मु-
ख्या, f. a species of plant (= अज-मोदा).
—फल-
मुद्गरिका, f. a kind of date tree (= पिण्ड-खर्-
जूरी).
—फल-मूल, अम्, n. or ए, n. du. or आनि,
n. pl. fruits and roots.
—फलमूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
having (edible) fruits and roots.
—फल-योग, अस्,
m. the attainment of an object; remuneration, wages.
—फल-राजन्, आ, m. ‘king of the fruits,’ a water-
melon.
—फल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, fruit-bearing, fruc-
tiferous, covered or laden with fruits, fruitful; yielding
results or consequences, successful, profitable, advan-
tageous; containing the result or end of a plot; (अती),
f. a species of plant (= प्रियङ्गु; cf. फलिनी).
—फलवत्-त्व, अम्, n. or फलवत्-ता, f. fruit-
fulness, beneficial results or consequences.
—फल-
वर्ति, इस्, f. (in medicine) a suppository.
—फल-
वर्तुल, अम्, n. a water-melon; (probably अस्, m.),
the plant Gardenia Latifolia.
—फल-वल्ली, f. a
series of quotients in the solution of certain arith-
metical problems.
—फल-विक्रयिन्, ई, इणी, m. f. a
fruit-seller, fruiterer, dealer in fruits.
—फल-वृक्-
ष, अस्, m. a fruit tree.
—फल-वृक्षक, अस्, m.
the bread-fruit tree.
—फल-शाडव, अस्, m. the
pomegranate tree.
—फलशालि-त्व, अम्, n. the bear-
ing of fruit; experience of consequences or results.
—फल-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bearing or yielding fruit;
experiencing consequences, sharing in results.
—फ-
ल-शैशिर, अस्, m. Zizyphus Jujuba (= बदर).
—फल-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. ‘best of fruits,’ the
mango tree.
—फल-संस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing
fruit.
—फल-सम्पद्, त्, f. abundance of fruit,
good result, success, prosperity.
—फल-सम्बद्-
ध, अस्, m. ‘fruit-endowed,’ the tree Ficus Glome-
rata.
—फल-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, or फल-
सम्भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, produced in or by fruit.
—फ-
ल-सम्भारा, f. ‘having an abundance of fruit,’ the
tree Ficus Oppositifolia.
—फल-सहस्र, अम्, n.
a thousand fruits; (ए), n. du. two thousand fruits.
—फल-साधन, अम्, n. a means of effecting any
result.
—फल-सिद्धि, इस्, f. acquiring fruit, reaping
fruit, realising an object; a prosperous issue.
—फल-
स्थान, अम्, n. the stage in which fruits or results
are enjoyed.
—फल-स्नेह, अस्, m. ‘having oil in
the fruit,’ a walnut tree.
—फल-हानि, इस्, f. loss
of fruit or profit.
—फल-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, fruit-
seizing, stealing fruits.
—फल-हारी, f. an epithet
of Kālī (a form of Durgā).
—फल-हीन, अस्, आ,
अम्, void of fruit, yielding no profit.
—फल-
हेतु, उस्, उस्, उ, one who has results for a motive,
acting with a view to results.
—फलाकाङ्क्षा
(˚ल-आक्˚), f. hope or expectation of favourable con-
sequences.
—फलाकाङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, desirous of
results, wishing for favourable consequences.
—फ-
लागम (˚ल-आग्˚), अस्, m. ‘arrival of fruits,’ the fruit
season, autumn.
—फलाढ्या (˚ल-आढ्˚), f. ‘rich
in fruit,’ a variety of the plantain (= काष्ठ-कदली).
—फलादन (˚ल-अद्˚), अस्, m. ‘fruit-eater,’ a
parrot; [cf. फलाशन.]
—फलाध्यक्ष (˚ल-
अध्˚), अम्, n. ‘superintendant of fruits,’ the tree
Mimusops Kauki.
—फलानुबन्ध (˚ल-अन्˚),
अस्, m. sequence or succession of results, consequences,
results.
—फलानुमेय (˚ल-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, in-
ferable from consequences or results.
—फलानुस-
रण (˚ल-अन्˚), अम्, n. rate or aggregate of profits.
—फलान्त (˚ल-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘ending with fruit,’
a bamboo (which dies away after bearing fruit).
—फलान्वेषिन् (˚ल-अन्˚), ई, इणी, इ, seeking fruits
or results, looking for a reward.
—फलापेक्षा
(˚ल-अप्˚), f. regard to results, expectation of conse-
quences.
—फलापेत (˚ल-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, de-
prived of fruit, unproductive, unfertile.
—फलाफ-
लिका (˚ल-अफ्˚), f., see Gaṇa Śāka-pārthivādi to
Vārttika to Pāṇ. II. 1, 69.
—फलाबन्ध्य (˚ल-
अब्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not barren of fruit, bearing fruit;
[cf. फल-बन्ध्य.]
—फलाभोग (˚ल-अभ्˚),
[]
अस्, m. non-enjoyment of profits, &c.
—फलाम्ल
(˚ल-अम्˚), अस्, m. a species of sorrel, Rumex Vesi-
carius; (अम्), n. a tamarind.
—फलाम्ल-पञ्चक
(˚ल-अम्˚), अम्, n. the five acid or sour fruits, viz.
bergamot, orange, sorrel, tamarind, and citron; [cf.
अम्ल-पञ्च and फल-पञ्चाम्ल.]
—फलाम्-
लिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) accompanied with sauce
prepared from sour tamarind juice.
—फलाराम
(˚ल-आर्˚), अस्, m. a fruit-garden, orchard.
—फला-
शन (˚ल-अश्˚), अस्, m. ‘fruit-eater,’ a parrot; [cf.
फलादन.]
—फलाशिन् (˚ल-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ, feed-
ing or living on fruits.
—फलासक्त (˚ल-आस्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, attached to fruit or results, acting for the
sake of reward; fond of fruit, seeking to pluck fruit.
—फलासव (˚ल-आस्˚), अस्, m. a decoction of
fruits.
—फलास्थि (˚ल-अस्˚), इ, n. ‘having a hard
kernel for fruit,’ a cocoa-nut.
—फलाहार (˚ल-आह्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, feeding or living on fruits, gathering
fruits.
—फले-ग्रहि or फले-ग्राहि, इस्, इस्, इ, or
फले-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bearing fruit in season, fruitful
(= फल-ग्रहि).
—फलेन्द्र (˚ल-इन्˚), अस्, m.
‘fruit-king,’ a species of Eugenia (= राज-जम्बू).
—फले-पाक, फले-पाका, फले-पाकु, see Gaṇa
to Pāṇ. VII. 3, 53.
—फले-पुष्पा, f. a kind of small
shrub (= द्रोण-पुष्पी).
—फले-रुहा, f. the
trumpet-flower, Bignonia Suaveolens.
—फलोच्चय
(˚ल-उच्˚), अस्, m. the collecting of fruits, a collection
of fruits.
—फलोत्तमा (˚ल-उत्˚), f. ‘best of fruits,’
a kind of grape without stones (= काकली-द्राक्षा);
a black grape; the three myrobalans (= त्रि-फला);
the benefit arising from sacred study (?); a small
sort of rope (?).
—फलोत्पति (˚ल-उत्˚), इस्, m.
the mango tree; (perhaps incorrectly for फलोत्-
पत्ति.)
—फलोत्पत्ति (˚ल-उत्˚), इस्, f. production
of fruit, profit, gain, advantage.
—फलोदक (˚ल-
उद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Yakṣa.
—फलोदय (˚ल-
उद्˚), अस्, m. coming forth or appearance of fruit;
profit, advantage, gain; appearance of consequences
or results, consequence, result, recompense, reward,
retribution, punishment; happiness, joy; heaven,
paradise.
—फलोद्गम (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, m. the pro-
duction of fruit, appearance of fruit.
—फलोद्देश
(˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, m. regard to results.
—फलोद्भव
(˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, obtained or derived from fruits.
—फलोपजीविन् (˚ल-उप्˚), ई, इनी, इ, living by the
cultivation or sale of fruits.
—फलोपेत (˚ल-उप्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, possessing fruits, yielding fruit.

फाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a ploughshare, (Sāy. =
भूमि-विदारक-काष्ठ); a kind of hoe or
shovel; a bundle; the forehead; (अस्), m. a citron
tree; an epithet of Mahā-deva; of Bala-rāma; =
उत्-प्लुति; (अस्, ई, अम्), made of cotton (as a gar-
ment; in this sense perhaps fr. फल).
—फाल-
कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, tilled with the plough, ploughed,
furrowed; growing on arable land, produced by
cultivation; (अम्), n. ploughed or cultivated soil, a
ploughed field; अ-फालकृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, grow-
ing on uncultivated soil, growing wild.
—फाल-
गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘ploughshare-defended,’ an epi-
thet of Bala-rāma; [cf. हलायुध.]
—फाल-दती,
f. ‘having teeth like ploughshares,’ N. of a female
demon.
—फालाहत (˚ल-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘struck
with the ploughshare,’ ploughed.
फाल फाल. See col. 1.

फलक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (at the end of an adj.
comp., f. इका), = फल, fruit, result, consequence,
profit, gain; menstruation [cf. नव-फलिकी]; a
shield; (अस्), m. the plant Mesua Roxburghii;
(अम्), n. a board, lath, plank, a bench; a slab at the
base (of a pedestal; cf. स्फटिक-फ्˚); any flat sur-
face [cf. फणा-फ्˚]; a slab or tablet for writing on
[cf. चित्र-फ्˚, लिपि-फ्˚]; a leaf or page for writing
on; the stand on which a Buddhist priest keeps
his turban; a broad and flat bone, the os frontis or
bone of the forehead; the palm of the hand; the
buttocks; a particular vessel; a kind of cloth; the
top or head of an arrow; the pericarp of a lotus;
(आ), f. a various reading for हलका in Gaṇa Prek-
ṣādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
—फलक-पाणि, इस्, m. a
soldier armed with a shield.
—फलक-पुर, अम्,
n., N. of a town in the east of India; [cf. फल-
पुर.]
—फलक-यन्त्र, अम्, n. an astronomical
instrument invented by Bhāskara.
—फलक-सक्-
थ, अम्, n. a thigh like a board, (Scholiast on Pāṇ.
V. 4, 98.)
